key_insight: Cartridges-style KV cache compression improves document-grounded answers, but can weaken the model’s off-context behavior unless it is adapted for query routing or mixed training.
engineering_relevance: For long-context LLM serving, cache compression should be judged not only by on-document accuracy but also by preservation of general knowledge, instruction following, and resistance to context contamination.
method: Cartridges++ router: choose at inference time whether a query uses compressed long-context memory or the original path.
Cartridges++ data-mixing: include a small share of off-document Q/A pairs during training.
Evaluate compressed KV methods on both on-context and off-context behaviors, not just document utility.
evidence_signal: The paper compares Cartridges and heuristic variants using on-context document queries plus off-context checks for contamination, general knowledge retention, and instruction following.
watch_item: A router adds inference-time decision logic, and mixed training may require careful tuning so the compression gain does not erode memory savings or introduce routing errors.
paper_title: Cartridges++: KV Cache Compression without Off-Context Derailment
